rw.headline: Head of Category, Grocery & FMCG
rw.summary: Runs the FMCG and Grocery vertical at Ninjacart, with 10+ years across category management, growth and engineering. Has owned category P&L (60% of revenue), run daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs in 30+ cities, and product-managed apps with engineering teams. Bengaluru-based; B.E. in Computer Science.
relevant: Category P&L: heads FMCG and Grocery at Ninjacart; earlier managed P&L for key categories at 60% of revenue and 5x daily volumes in 100 days
Pricing and data: daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs in 30+ cities; works in SQL, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Analytics
Brands and suppliers: vendor negotiations and brand/seller relationships at Ninjacart; built a 500+ supplier network at Fashinza
Product and teams: product managed seller and buyer apps with engineering at Ninjacart; led cross-functional teams of 250+ across layers

roles.title: Director, FMCG and Grocery
bullets: Own category management and P&L for the FMCG and Grocery vertical, including retail strategy implementation
Set pricing strategies and optimize inventory across the category
Lead vendor negotiations and manage relationships with key brands and sellers
Run market intelligence and product selection to keep the assortment aligned with demand
Product managed the full development and deployment of seller and buyer facing applications, working closely with tech and engineering teams

roles.title: Associate Director, Growth & Revenue
bullets: Managed a $5M portfolio at 20% EBITDA, with 30% YoY revenue growth and positive cash flow
Drove online revenue market share from 8% to 55% in 18 months
Delivered >10X ROI on Performance Marketing, generating $1.3M in revenue on $100K spend
Reduced CAC and optimized marketing spend
Improved engagement, retention and user stickiness by optimizing Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) campaigns
Collaborated with engineering and design teams to drive measurable growth in adoption and engagement

roles.title: Senior Manager, Category Management and Operations
bullets: Built a network of 500+ suppliers and managed the full supplier base for sourcing
Scaled monthly GMV to $100K within a year, setting up core backend functions from scratch
Led development of product assortments aligned with customer preferences and market demand
Collaborated with engineering and design teams on product launches

roles.title: Senior Manager, Category Management
bullets: Managed P&L for key categories contributing 60% of revenue
Drove 5x growth in daily volumes within 100 days
Led P&L optimization and market intelligence for 30+ cities
Conducted daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Led the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including design and implementation of business-critical applications
Analyzed key performance drivers
Managed incident resolution across multiple channels and integrated new technologies and automation into existing systems

extra_sections.title: Entrepreneurial Ventures
items: Valarlife: launched an online spirulina and moringa health supplement store. Revenue generated: $200K; funding: $100K
Fraternitee: B2B apparel manufacturing for schools, colleges, startups, corporates and NGOs. Revenue generated: $250K

Useful for a South region role spanning Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad

rw.referral_note: Hi, I'm applying for Head of Category – Grocery & FMCG at Zepto. I currently run the FMCG and Grocery vertical at Ninjacart. Earlier there I managed category P&L at 60% of revenue and ran daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs in 30+ cities. I'm Bengaluru-based and have an engineering background. Could you refer me or point me to the hiring manager?
rw.fit_line: Strong on category P&L, pricing benchmarks, SQL and product/engineering collaboration; the gaps are quick-commerce or dark-store experience, a new-city launch, and named national FMCG brand negotiations, plus a team of 10+ that the résumé only supports through the 250+ cross-functional figure. Apply, and expect questions on those and on the broad scope and missing pay details in the posting.

problems.claim: Summary and relevant bullet: "daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs in 30+ cities"
problems.reason: The original attributes 30+ cities to P&L optimization and market intelligence, and separately attributes daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs to the same Ninjacart Chennai role. It does not say benchmarking covered 30+ cities. The rewrite merges the two facts into one claim.

problems.claim: Summary: "run daily price benchmarking" (present tense) and "Pricing and data" bullet presented as current work
problems.reason: Daily price benchmarking is listed under Ninjacart (Chennai), Apr'18–Mar'21, not the current Director role. Presenting it in the present tense implies it is a current responsibility, which the original does not support.
The original title is "Director, FMCG and Grocery" at Ninjacart. "Head of Category" is not a title that appears anywhere in the original profile. The job title has been changed.
